hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/FEEDBACK.md"; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; n=$(awk '/^## Open$/{o=1;next} /^## /{o=0} o && /^- \[ \] /{n++} END{print n+0}' "$f"); [ "$n" -gt 0 ] || exit 0; case "$n" in 1) w="entry";; *) w="entries";; esac; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"%s open feedback %s from the panel in FEEDBACK.md — run /feedback-triage to work through them."}}\n' "$n" "$w"
